Detailed Description

routines used by several of the ia_*.c (icon-animation plugins).

this is used by several of the actual plugins, so no code that is used only by a single plug-in should end up in here.

) 
 

resize and/or fade icon.

Parameters:
el - icon-element to apply the action to
evas - canvas the object lives on
c - grow by c pixels (0...oo)
alpha - transparency (0.0 ... 1.0)
x - x-position
y - y-position
s - affect only elements that have at least on of the states in s, and are of the "image" type.
